_doc: Config of run.py. Protocol: scratch design DESIGN.md section 5 (arms 5.2, workloads 5.3, pass criteria 5.4). {name} placeholders come from vars (override with --var name=value) plus {rundir} (per-start output dir). Flag spellings follow compat/strata/strata-ext/src/retier_loop.cpp. Fixed setup of the 2026-11-18 S8 run: --adapt-every 64 --adapt-swaps 8 and STRATA_DISJOINT_ADAPT=1 on EVERY arm (heat exists only with the adapt flags; the matched arms must share the engine's own adaptation).

vars.gpu: UNSET: pass --var gpu=<the CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES value: a device index or a GPU UUID; a UUID identifies one machine, so it is never kept in the repo>
vars.rocm: UNSET: pass --var rocm=<the ROCm install dir>
vars.pack: UNSET: pass --var pack=<the model pack dir>

io_patterns.os_read_mb: file tier I/O this request: the OS read ([0-9.]+) MB

io_patterns_file_note: PROVISIONAL (track FR-D): the four file_* / bad_sum patterns above assume ONE engine log line, `helper file io: direct_bytes=N buffered_bytes=N reads=N bad_sum=N`, carrying the helper Header counters file_direct_bytes, file_buffered_bytes, file_reads and the kTierBadSum count (cumulative). Tracks FR-E/FR-H define the real line; change these four regexes (the only place) to match, and the F1 verdict follows.

P2z.note: A/A: --retier-moves 1 makes the planner's pair budget max_moves/2 = 0 (planner.rs:276) while retier_check still accepts it (it refuses 0)

F0.note: file-moves persona, reference: the ladder on, every move by bytes (blob path); identical to F1 but for --retier-file-moves

F1.note: file-moves persona: the ladder on, an NVMe-only expert's move is loaded by the helper straight from the model file (needs <pack>/expert-sums.v1, built by seabraid-sums)

M.note: main card alone: W4 quality baseline, no helper flag

W0._doc: 3 x 600 tokens = about 300 decode windows: with --retier-every 128 a round fires in request 2 (400 tokens, one request, is under 128 windows)

W6._doc: Host-RAM headroom (maintainer decision 1). The engine's own RAM limit is --resident-budget-gib (the tier-0 resident RAM budget; DESIGN-LOG 'RAM budget 6 vs 10 GiB', install/config.py). One variable per comparison: moves off (P0) vs on (P2) at each fixed budget, and a budget varied with the arm fixed. The three budgets are PROVISIONAL (the owner sets them from the host's real headroom); SEABRAID_STRATA_EXCLUDE_HELPER_RAM is held at the engine env's value in every cell.

W7._doc: Decode-path quality (C10). W4 teacher-forces a PREFILL where the helper tier never runs (live run G1 2026-11-19: tier on and off gave byte-identical W4 rows), so W7 teacher-forces a fixed continuation through the real decode windows (Strata force_check.py score --path decode: STRATA_FOLLOW, top-32 rows) with the tier engaged. One start = one capture command; it starts its own engine from the arm's forced_cfg (an engine config: exe, args, env, lib_dirs). All arms read the SAME forced_set (force_check.py gen, from the main-card-alone engine), so the targets match and tools/kl.py refuses any pair that did not. M is the reference (lowest M start) and a second M start is the noise floor; P0 (tier engaged, moves off) and P2 (live moves) are gated against it. G1 used 6 prompts x 400 forced tokens and the interleave M C0 C1 M C1 C0.

W8._doc: FR-A1 per-move cost (FR DESIGN 9): blob (F0) against file (F1) moves at the (h2, F) and (h1, h2) hops; the round lines carry ms per hop (fence_us), the helper counters carry bytes moved; main RSS and page-cache growth are read from /proc by the owner's window script. --retier-margin 1.0 so rounds fire in the first request. Bar: no hop slower by more than 10%.

W9._doc: FR-A2 hot cache: the same arms, once cold and once with the climbers' pages pre-warmed in main's page cache (variant warm sets QUAL_PREWARM_PACK=1, which the launcher is expected to honour by reading the pack before the engine starts: PROVISIONAL, the launcher is the owner's). Decides the mincore rule.

W10._doc: FR-A3 decode: tok/s with the ladder on, file moves on vs off, same budget, default policy margin. Bar for default-on: tok/s no worse than -1% with a measurable RAM saving. NOT covered here: the KL gate of FR-A3 (W7 is the decode-path KL; adding F0/F1 forced configs to it is a follow-up for the owner's window).

thresholds.fence_p95_ms_note: PROVISIONAL (the maintainers may change it); C1 is the real arbiter
